propertySets.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeSparkGap
propertySets.definition: Spark gap properties used in energy domain. The property set can be used by the predefined type SPARKGAP and VOLTAGELIMITER of IfcProtectiveDevice.

properties.name: BreakdownVoltageTolerance
properties.definition: Nominal value of the spark gap breakdown voltage tolerance.

properties.name: Capacitance
properties.definition: Maximum value of the capacitance between the electrodes at specified frequency and temperature.

properties.name: CurrentRMS
properties.definition: Maximum rms (root mean square) current of an electric-electronic or electromechanical component at specified ambient temperature.

properties.name: PowerDissipation
properties.definition: Permissible power which may be dissipated continuously, at specified conditions.

properties.name: Resistivity
properties.definition: Electrical resistivity of a rock or soil (Ohm-m).
